design: Two named dispatcher operators: embedding forward retains F.embedding(ids, FP32 weight).to(requested output dtype); consumer backward calls the unchanged prebuilt grid[2] kernel through the installed supported NKI registration/bridge.

Attach register_autograd to the forward operator; setup_context saves exactly counts, starts, positions and maximums. Backward calls the registered consumer on gradient.contiguous() and returns FP32 dW plus None for all nondifferentiable arguments. No global tensor/metadata cache, new cast, fused BF16 boundary or hidden fallback.

The installed nki_op signature, wrap_nki contract, grid[2] preservation, forward ATen-composition support, FakeTensor handling and registration method are unresolved. Inspect exact installed source first; do not invent imports or assume torch.library.custom_op is lowerable by the Neuron backend.
First-order diagnostic only; higher-order differentiation remains unsupported/unqualified. No production embedding substitution or optimization claim.

Inject zero/stale output to prove strict failure reporting. Check registration/fake/alias contracts separately; CPU 2.13 cannot certify installed native 2.11.
